name: Stealing Supplies

meta.previous: Gelkis Alliance, Raid on the Kolkar

summary: In Desolace, Uthek the Wise sends you east after the Magram’s stores. The Gelkis believe meat gives them strength, while the Magram keep supplies for the days between hunts.

sections.title: Meat and Strength
sections.body: Uthek the Wise says the Gelkis draw strength from meat. A full belly fights harder than an empty one. The Magram keep extra stores for the days between hunts. So you are sent to their village to the east for six bags of crudely dried meat, to bring back to Uthek at the Gelkis Village.

faq.q: Who sends you to take these supplies?
faq.answer: Uthek the Wise of the Gelkis sends you from Desolace.

faq.q: Why does Uthek want the Magram meat taken?
faq.answer: The Gelkis believe meat gives them strength. Uthek says taking the Magram’s reserve would weaken them as they fight between hunts.

faq.q: Where are the Magram supplies kept?
faq.answer: The Magram keep their supplies in their village to the east.

faq.q: How much meat does Uthek want?
faq.answer: Uthek the Wise wants six bags of crudely dried meat, brought to him at the Gelkis Village.
